cain--cain-habano.description: Cain Habano is Oliva's straight-ligero blend, introduced in 2009 and rolled in Estelí: a Nicaraguan Habano wrapper and Nicaraguan binder around ligero from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa, triple-fermented to soften its edge. Earth and cocoa come first, cream and coffee fill the middle, and pepper and strength gather in the last third.

thirds.notes: Subdued at first: earth and light cocoa, with cinnamon-like spice and pepper kept in the background.
Creaminess takes over, carrying cocoa, coffee and a fruity sweetness while the spice holds steady.
The cigar comes alive with pepper and spice over earth, and the strength builds noticeably.

cain--cain-maduro.description: Cain Maduro wraps Oliva's triple-fermented straight-ligero filler from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa, with a Nicaraguan binder, in a dark, oily maduro leaf, made at the Oliva factory in Estelí. Retail notes point to dark chocolate, espresso and hickory; reviewers find it smooth and dense rather than layered, with oak and a sweet maduro character that change little.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Cain Maduro Torpedo review

cain--cain-f.description: Cain F, the F standing for 'forced refined', is a Nicaraguan puro from Oliva built on ligero from Estelí, Condega and Jalapa and rolled at the Oliva factory in Estelí. Pepper runs through the whole smoke, with dark fruit and cocoa early, cedar, coffee and leather in the middle, and an earthier, calmer close.

thirds.notes: Pepper leads, sharp and sinus-clearing, with dark cherry or raisin and cocoa beneath.
Pepper holds the centre, with cedar, light coffee and leather filling in behind.
The spice eases; cedar and earth come forward with coffee and a return of dark fruit.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Cain F Lancero
Cigar Dojo – Cain F Straight Ligero Lancero review

cain--cain-daytona.description: Cain Daytona is the gentler branch of Oliva's Cain family, with a Nicaraguan Habano wrapper and Nicaraguan binder over ligero from the Jalapa Valley alone. It trades raw power for flavour: cedar, nuts and a light sweetness, a seasoned, Cajun-like spice that stays from start to finish, and a hint of citrus at the end.

thirds.notes: Immediate spice, like seasoned roasted corn husk, over a pecan-like nuttiness.
The spice carries on and the profile gains a slightly malty depth.
Light citrus appears in the last puffs while the spice and complexity hold to the end.
